findings.cause: payments-api was redeployed at 2026-11-20T19:07:06Z with CHARGE_AMOUNT_UNIT=dollars. Since then the provider has been charged 100x what we record. Our payments table keeps the amount in cents (pmt_000245: 1396 cents, $13.96), but the provider's charge pay_000245 is 139600 cents ($1,396.00). The cents value is apparently being sent as if it were dollars, or scaled by 100. Every payment from pmt_000245 on is affected, so payments_match_provider fails with 'amount differs'. The findings grew from 59 when the alert fired to 92 at c1, so the problem is still going on. The ledger books what the provider reports, so the ledger agrees with the provider (matches_provider passes) at the inflated amounts. Customers are being overcharged 100x.
